name: Echoes of Eternity
source:
What do you do when even death won't grant you peace?

When Era died, she was told of an afterlife filled with glimmering tranquillity. The reality was far from it. Forced to place her trust in a mysterious cloaked figure, she is sent to live through small fragments of her past, tasked with coming to terms with the horrors of her life in order to seek an afterlife of peace.

[From [url=https://summer-light-studios.itch.io/echoes-of-eternity]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当死亡也无法给你带来平安时，你会怎么做？

当埃拉去世时，她被告知来世充满了微光般的宁静。现实却远非如此。她被迫信任一个神秘的披着斗篷的人物，她被派去经历她过去的碎片，她的任务是接受她生活中的恐怖，以寻求来世的和平。

[来自[url=https://summer-light-studios.itch.io/echoes-of-eternity]itch.io[/url]]
